verdicts_before.value: 0 file(s) before, 40 after, for 30 document(s)
verdicts_before.threshold: the folder is empty before the press (the vacuity guard: a folder that already held files would prove nothing about it), the store has documents, and the folder holds at least one file per document afterward

verdicts_before.value: state "40 files, last written just now." (expected count 40), where "The mirror is written to <scratch>/project" (names the directory: true)
verdicts_before.threshold: the state sentence names the count the rig itself counted on disk, and the where sentence named the WHOLE directory the rig handed the host. Not its basename: the sentence is "The mirror is written to {dir}", so a basename check passed on the word "mirror" appearing in its own wording, which this rig's first green run did

verdicts_before.value: mirrored [project] (expected "project")
verdicts_before.threshold: settings.json's mirrored list includes this project's own slug

verdicts_before.value: 1 row(s) offered in the same process that wrote the folder, the edited document among them (restarted: false)
verdicts_before.threshold: the change panel offers the outside edit as a row without the application being restarted, and one of those rows names the document that was edited. This is the PANEL's own scan on open, not the watcher's -- a sabotage with the watcher disabled still passes it, which is why the watcher has a gate of its own below

verdicts_before.value: 13020 ms after the typing (the store's rev moved; the outside edit led by 11041 ms) the file still holds the words the writer put in it
verdicts_before.threshold: the typing reached the store (its rev moved -- otherwise no pass was owed and the file is unchanged for free), a pass window of at least 10000 ms went by AFTER the typing, and the file the writer edited from outside still holds their words. That is what the in-process watcher buys: it notices the edit in time to PAUSE the entry, so the pass leaves the file alone. With the watcher disabled this goes red and the panel gate above does not

verdicts_before.value: row state "The words changed here and in your book" (expected "The words changed here and in your book")
verdicts_before.threshold: the conflicted row's state sentence equals the page's own catalog sentence for it
